obligations.definition: Each way contains 128 rows of four 14-bit target entries and four 30-bit metadata entries. The lookup edge captures f0_valid, row pc[10:4] and full pc. Memory read output is current contents of that captured row when captured valid is one, and unknown otherwise. Each slot compares the29 low bits of its metadata with captured pc[39:11], with no separate valid bit. Either matching way is a hit; way0 has priority if both match. Therefore zeroed tags can hit tag zero. Target bits13:1 hold a signed13-bit offset and bit0 selects extended target; metadata bit29 classifies branch, zero classifies jump.

obligations.definition: A lookup result target for slot j is captured PC plus the sign-extended13-bit offset plus2*j, modulo40 bits, unless the selected target entry's extended bit is one, in which case it is the extended-memory read value. The supplied extended memory has16 rows with folded row h(R)=R[3:0] XOR zero-extended R[6:4]. It captures the current read enable and folded lookup row each edge, returns unknown when that enable is zero, and shares one40-bit target across all slots and both ways for that row. Its writes use the previous edge's captured folded update row, while data and write enable are current delayed-update controls. It has no reset clearing.

obligations.definition: At every edge the f3 override flag captures the f2 override flag, and f3 prediction fields capture the pre-edge merged f2 PC/valid/branch/jump fields. f3 chooses those captured fields on its delayed override, otherwise current upstream f3 fields. f3 taken ORs current upstream f3 taken with the correspondingly delayed hit AND valid-jump injection. obligations.definition: A reset edge sets sweep active and index zero. Each nonreset edge seeing sweep active writes all four target entries and all four metadata entries to zero in both ways at the current sweep index, then increments the7-bit index; the edge with pre-index127 ends the sweep. Extended writes remain independent. Lookup and output pipelines keep advancing. Compare all native outputs, including invalid-cycle PC bits, upstream fields and replacement metadata; full-width PCs, per-slot masks and both ways remain independent.
